name: Pickup Item
description: Something players pick up with E (or the phone's action button), carry in the right hand, drop and throw. The Multiplayer Server decides who holds it, and the player sees it in hand at once. Works with: Work Station.

changelog.notes: Initial release: one holder at a time decided by the Multiplayer Server, held in the right hand and shown at once, a floating prompt with the device's own control, drop, optional throw, endless supply crates, and a script API to read, give and take what players carry.
